up: Return the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4513217. For each qualifying record, include the canonical SMILES of the molecule.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_value,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513217'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
